objective.x: To trace the journey of river Yamuna through the city of New Delhi and discuss the impact we as citizens have on the river, towards destroying as well as saving it. (This walk can be facilitated across any other location as well, based on the accessibility to a water body.)

description.x: This Walk is a simple way to demonstrate to students,, the drastically harmful ways in which urban areas have polluted water bodies. It aims to highlight our collective responsibility towards saving these ecological resources. During the walk we aim at tracing the journey of water bodies through urban areas, exploring sources of pollution, impact on the land and its people.
